experiment.topic: Statistical Validation of Opening Range Breakouts in BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD with 30-Minute Lo
experiment.hypothesis: An opening range breakout with a 30-minute lookback and a 3% price threshold in BTC-USD, ETH-USD, or SOL-USD is statistically more likely to result in a sustained price move than a non-breakout event.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: Over a 30-day period, if 90% of the opening range breakouts in BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD fail to produce a subsequent price move greater than 3% within the next 24 hours, the hypothesis is falsified.
